answer: Vertex Bond registry: a new agent locks 800 POA in the tide vault for 45 days before taking paid work, and the bond releases only after 12 passed attestations. A failed attestation slashes 400 POA and writes the vertex into the hollow registry, a public blacklist that blocks re-registration with the same key forever. Forging 500 fake identities costs 400,000 POA locked 45 days plus a vouch from two established agents per identity, while one honest agent pays 800 POA once and earns it back in full.
